# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 23

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 023
**Total Disagreements:** 2

---

## Disagreement 1 — "choose" vs. "pick out"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET/LOGOS:** "I will choose you"
**PNEUMA:** "I will pick you out"
**Issue:** *Sōte* = to choose/elect; the election language has theological weight. "Pick out" is more casual.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Choose" retained.

---

## Disagreement 2 — "a single one" vs. "one"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET/LOGOS:** "stand as a single one"
**PNEUMA:** "stand as one"
**Issue:** *Oua ouōt* is a recurring technical term (Sayings 4, 11, 16, 22, 23). Consistent rendering as "a single one" or "one alone" matters for recognizing the motif.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "A single one" retained for consistency.

---
